Here is the part-of-speech analysis for the sentence: "While I was walking through the park, I stumbled upon an old, mysterious book that was hidden beneath a pile of leaves."

1.  **While**: Subordinating Conjunction
2.  **I**: Pronoun (Subject)
3.  **was**: Verb (Auxiliary/Helping Verb)
4.  **walking**: Verb (Present Participle/Main Verb)
5.  **through**: Preposition
6.  **the**: Determiner (Article)
7.  **park**: Noun (Object of the preposition)
8.  **,**: Punctuation
9.  **I**: Pronoun (Subject)
10. **stumbled**: Verb (Main Verb)
11. **upon**: Preposition
12. **an**: Determiner (Article)
13. **old**: Adjective
14. **,**: Punctuation
15. **mysterious**: Adjective
16. **book**: Noun (Object of the preposition)
17. **that**: Pronoun (Relative Pronoun)
18. **was**: Verb (Auxiliary/Helping Verb)
19. **hidden**: Verb (Past Participle)
20. **beneath**: Preposition
21. **a**: Determiner (Article)
22. **pile**: Noun (Object of the preposition)
23. **of**: Preposition
24. **leaves**: Noun (Object of the preposition)
25. **.**: Punctuation

The fastest land animal in the world is the cheetah.
